gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: She was on the verge of ___ up her job to sail around the world.
gaps.explanation: 'On the verge of' ends in a preposition, so the gerund follows.

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
I look forward to ___ you at the reunion.
gaps.explanation: 'To' is a preposition here, so the gerund follows.

gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.

gaps.sentence: I remembered ___ the door, so I went back to check.
gaps.explanation: remember + -ing = recall a past action; remember to do = not forget a duty.

gaps.sentence: I'm learning ___ the guitar at the moment.
gaps.explanation: learn takes the to-infinitive (learn how to play).
